description:
The investigator (backend/investigator) on the Skeptic's fault-injection clips
(evaluation/experiments/skeptic_faults.py: same scenes, same faults, same
cached renders).

Question: when the Skeptic blocks a reconstruction, does the investigator
recover a CORRECT answer, and does it ever turn a refusal into a wrong one?

Per clip, for the base pipeline and for the investigator's final case:
  answered     speeds reported and no blocking dispute / rejection
  worst error  largest |relative speed error| of a reported (non-withheld) speed
  covered      every reported speed's 90 % interval contains the true speed
  harmful      answered, no flag, and worst error > 10 %

  python3 investigator_faults.py --n 8   -> evaluation/results/investigator_faults.json

requests.why: every speed scales with the frame rate; 30.0 fps comes from the file's metadata, which is often wrong. Confirm it if you know the camera's rate

trace.diagnosis: temporal_stability: the geometry of the two halves of the clip disagrees, so a single road geometry cannot be right for the whole clip
trace.action: measure the background's displacement through the clip and look for one abrupt shift; split at frame 60 and analyse each part separately
trace.observation: the scene shifted by 25.4 px at frame 60 (2.00 s) and stayed there
trace.decision: no part of the clip gives an undisputed reconstruction of the two vehicles: the dispute stands

trace.diagnosis: marking_standard: dashes cover 35% of each cycle; the assumed standard (carai_synthetic_centerline) says 25%
trace.action: look up documented standards whose duty cycle is consistent with the measured one (within 0.06, allowing up to 0.08 of upward measurement bias)
trace.observation: Austria motorway 6 m + 12 m (33%), Austria rural 6 m + 9 m (40%), CARAI synthetic 3 m + 9 m (25%), US MUTCD broken line 10 ft + 30 ft (25%), Caltrans freeway 12 ft + 36 ft (25%), France T1 3 m + 10 m (23%)
trace.decision: allowing for the measurement's known upward bias (up to 0.08), the assumed standard cannot be ruled out, and under it the reconstruction is disputed; the dispute stands
